title: Habitat Eart
overview: Discover the wondrous connections that sustain life on Planet Earth. Habitat Earth takes audiences on a spectacular journey into the inner workings of nature's complex networks, showing how ecological communities—from microscopic fungi chains beneath the forest floor to global ocean currents—are deeply intertwined. What we do to our planet shapes the survival of all living things.
